derived_observations: At each sampled hour and case, four PLANT requests are projected but only one PLANT changes World State.
All 64 sampled MELON PLANT requests fail to become MELON State-entry.
All sampled PLANT no-ops are explained by the public-rule target tile already being non-empty when the later unit executes.
The observed failure is therefore a repeated Action -> World Transformation boundary at the sampled Day4 planting turns, not merely absence of MELON from Action Projection.
The repeated no-ops do not imply 64 independently lost productive assets: multiple requests target the same tile, so request count must not be interpreted as unique lost capacity.
The audit establishes persistence of the transformation failure but does not establish its terminal value or that changing execution/projection would improve terminal self.
